Hello HeliumDeploy Affiliate Team,

My name is Adeoye A., and I am currently an affiliate partner with
HeliumDeploy through UpPromote.

I would like to request that the email address associated with my
HeliumDeploy affiliate account be changed.

Current affiliate email:
(email hidden)

New affiliate email:
(email hidden)

My UpPromote affiliate account currently shows an active HeliumDeploy
partnership with 1 referral and approximately $90.47 in pending commission.

UpPromote Support has advised me that I can contact the individual
merchants to update the email address on my affiliate account and that
changing the email will not affect my paid or unpaid commissions.

Could you please update my HeliumDeploy affiliate account to the new email
address and confirm that my existing referral, pending commission,
affiliate link, and commission history will remain associated with my
account?

Thank you very much for your assistance.

Best regards,
Adeoye A.
KingdomAffiliateOffers
Handed to the team · Affiliate account change in UpPromote, not something I can do from the store sid

Hi Adeoye,

Thanks for the clear details, that makes it easy.

Affiliate accounts sit in UpPromote rather than on the store side, so I can't make the change myself. I've passed it to a colleague on our team today with both addresses, your referral and the pending commission balance, and they'll make the switch from (email hidden) to (email hidden)

Changing the email on an affiliate account doesn't detach the referral, the commission history or your affiliate link, so nothing should move. I'd rather my colleague confirm that for your specific account than promise it myself, and they'll do that in a reply to this thread.

Nothing further needed from you in the meantime.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
